scope: Proposition 8.7 (Saturation at inserted cuts) of the manuscript “Critical local smoothing for the three-dimensional wave equation” (preprints/Critical-local-smoothing-for-the-three-dimensional-wave-equation-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 079 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 79299093c07ea305), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 122. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose Γ > 0. In the outer closure of homogeneous free exponent data, let p0 be the minimal mass exponent at upper exponent Γ, and let d be the associated total-mass exponent. Then Γ = d + (1 − p0)/2, p0 ≥ 1, 0 < d ≤ 1. Fix any finite depth list. After realizing these data with arbitrarily small exterior errors, every regularity splitting preserving the terminal functional has limiting dominant regularity and summed energy described by κa = κsp0a+o(1) , Ea = es−da+o(1) . (CE) In particular, an arbitrarily short fixed final gap may be taken free, with a regularly split incoming state, when classifying terminal shapes. Equation (CE) denotes identities of exponent data in this outer closure; it does not assert that one inner sequence attains the closure extrema exactly.
